<p>今天为大家整理了 10 个优质的开源数据可视化大屏项目，涵盖 3D 地球、数字孪生、地图可视化等多种场景，技术栈涉及 Three.js、Vue3、React 等主流技术，非常适合学习和参考。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">一、数字孪生大屏</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">1. MF-TurbineMonitor - 风力发电机数字孪生</h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：大型涡轮扇叶风力发电机数据大屏案例，支持设备拆解组装、状态监控等功能。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2750e50ef5cc48f0af84ebc1b63cbbd4~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=j85AW3KBdAi9Nsw8trznqkf1vuI%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/170860a337ce46328e5af9a56f0f0a22~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=uQ86AK6BA2PktFAiM%2B4swJuyhUc%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ffengtianxi001.github.io%2FMF-TurbineMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-TurbineMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-TurbineM…</a></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffengtianxi001%2FMF-TurbineMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fengtianxi001/MF-TurbineMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/fengtianxi0…</a></p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite + Three.js</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>风机零部件高亮拾取</li>
<li>设备拆解与组装动画</li>
<li>偏航角数据绑定</li>
<li>部件状态实时监控</li>
<li>光线动效与信息面板</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">2. MF-StationMonitor - 变电站数字孪生大屏</h3>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/75f991abc5c045c283ee3c7dbf1b20ce~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=5PYE5MbLPN2GZ56YfKbkqHdQeaQ%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9b7a79b8b6f0414b918b3ce579360128~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=lXkr8kImW6LoLHdk3ShWLKopejc%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：变电站数字孪生可视化大屏，展示电力设备的运行状态。</p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ffengtianxi001.github.io%2FMF-StationMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-StationMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-StationM…</a></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffengtianxi001%2FMF-StationMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fengtianxi001/MF-StationMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/fengtianxi0…</a></p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">3. day-night-digital-twins - 智慧园区数字孪生</h3>
<h3 data-id="heading-4"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f40e69fc835b4cffb2090070aa164922~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=L5CXzw5vzz39Wb19Rmu1q3tAWTM%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></h3>
<h3 data-id="heading-5"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9874c674a68f4b5a9242369c5aaff640~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=zdxFm0HepJZ4BrsixJQAuvhgr%2Bg%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：智慧园区数字孪生项目，展示园区建筑的日夜场景切换。</p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgcat.cc%2Fdemo%2Fpark" target="_blank" title="https://gcat.cc/demo/park" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">gcat.cc/demo/park</a></p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：Three.js + GSAP + Webpack + GLSL Shader</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>日夜场景切换效果</li>
<li>GLSL 着色器特效</li>
<li>园区建筑 3D 展示</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-6"></h2>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">一、3D 地球可视化</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">4. 3d-earth - 炫酷 3D 地球大屏</h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：一个基于 WebGL 的 3D 地球可视化项目，展示了地球、星空背景、辉光大气层、城市标点、卫星环绕、飞线动画等特效。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/568defe1ffb046be848f86ad8624e8e1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=P%2FfTpWjoLhXJylj4W6eS6OWy%2FgQ%3D" alt="截屏2026-03-11 21.29.57.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgcat.cc%2Fdemo%2Fearth" target="_blank" title="https://gcat.cc/demo/earth" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">gcat.cc/demo/earth</a></p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：Three.js + TypeScript + Webpack + GSAP</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>地球表面纹理与星空背景</li>
<li>辉光与大气层效果</li>
<li>城市标签与标点系统</li>
<li>卫星环绕动画</li>
<li>国家/城市间飞线连接</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">5. MF-2.5DMap - 2.5D 地图可视化</h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：通过 GeoJSON 渲染 2.5D 地图的案例，支持行政区选择与开场动画。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e0028306ab044b389c4da04032356172~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=%2FBwuZPOwOoogMFthjH%2FMYBORhmI%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/aff71c01634c4ec2b3101bf732e28f7a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=W8UasgQKNF199eY9d1gW1hORStc%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ffengtianxi001.github.io%2FMF-2.5DMap" target="_blank" title="https://fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-2.5DMap" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-2.5DMap</a></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffengtianxi001%2FMF-2.5DMap" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fengtianxi001/MF-2.5DMap" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/fengtianxi0…</a></p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：Vue 3 + Three.js + Vite + Arco Design + Turf.js</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>基于 GeoJSON 数据渲染 3D 地图</li>
<li>自动调整相机位置与缩放比例</li>
<li>开场动画与行政区选择</li>
<li>使用 WGS84 坐标系直接渲染</li>
</ul>
<hr>

<h2 data-id="heading-11">三、网络安全与监控大屏</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">6. MF-NetworkMonitor - 网络安全数据大屏</h3>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f46e2cff7cb14beab820c14bc334824f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=OK%2BYwEEL2Zo5VNrP4jT4uBuxN8s%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：功能简洁的网络安全监控数据大屏案例。</p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ffengtianxi001.github.io%2FMF-NetworkMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-NetworkMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">fengtianxi001.github.io/MF-NetworkM…</a></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffengtianxi001%2FMF-NetworkMonitor" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fengtianxi001/MF-NetworkMonitor" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/fengtianxi0…</a></p>

<h2 data-id="heading-13">四、数据可视化组件</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">7. MF-PlaneGraph - 设备布置平面图编辑器</h3>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/271c91596a57439c836b777bd64e0256~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=80ENTUHNr916hBnckvpZVjtuLYw%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：一个可视化的设备布置平面图编辑器，支持拖拽编辑。</p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fmf-plane-graph.vercel.app%2F" target="_blank" title="https://mf-plane-graph.vercel.app/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">mf-plane-graph.vercel.app/</a></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffengtianxi001%2FMF-PlaneGraph" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fengtianxi001/MF-PlaneGraph" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/fengtianxi0…</a></p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">8. sc-datav - 四川省数据可视化大屏</h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：基于 React 和 Three.js 的四川省数据可视化大屏，包含多个演示案例。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6d7f2aff29164a72a4fc5624d14bffb3~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=yKxUc0cd3nR2FEqpzVCZbdRtV7Q%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e9e1d503064d4aa4ae77733c1e4c2c7d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=Ica9P2j8EWqiFol9DKyZ0ZYNl2A%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>在线演示</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fknight-l.github.io%2Fsc-datav%2F%23%2Fdemo0" target="_blank" title="https://knight-l.github.io/sc-datav/#/demo0" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Demo 0</a></li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fknight-l.github.io%2Fsc-datav%2F%23%2Fdemo1" target="_blank" title="https://knight-l.github.io/sc-datav/#/demo1" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Demo 1</a></li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fknight-l.github.io%2Fsc-datav%2F%23%2Fdemo2" target="_blank" title="https://knight-l.github.io/sc-datav/#/demo2" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Demo 2</a></li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fknight-l.github.io%2Fsc-datav%2F%23%2Fdemo3" target="_blank" title="https://knight-l.github.io/sc-datav/#/demo3" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Demo 3</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fknight-l%2Fsc-datav" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/knight-l/sc-datav" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/knight-l/sc…</a></p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Three.js + ECharts + GSAP + D3-geo</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>3D 地图渲染与轮廓飞线动画</li>
<li>侧边扫光视觉效果</li>
<li>多图表联动（柱状图、折线图）</li>
<li>响应式布局设计</li>
<li>Leva 实时调试面板</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">9. ThreeMaps - Vue3 + Three.js 数据大屏</h3>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：基于 Vue3 和 Three.js 开发的数据可视化大屏项目。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8ca78b43d5be4d7fa16b8211d10d0aa3~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=W%2F8XuMTY6sZvF1MoqwYhtAPNYfQ%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>开源地址</strong>：经协商请联系源作者（数字像素）购买</p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：Vue 3 + Three.js + Vite + ECharts + GSAP + D3-geo</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>3D 地图可视化</li>
<li>ECharts 图表集成</li>
<li>自适应布局（autofit.js）</li>
<li>交互式地图操作</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">五、高级 3D 渲染</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">10. webgi-jewelry - WebGi 珠宝展示页面</h3>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/592375dd623e45e59d8beaad5ec317be~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=pBpSfZ7%2FDbiTOaMrBNIqBavi5cM%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/920c64f31f5045d8ba8fedc77dbe3870~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5p-z5p2J:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1780386881&amp;x-signature=n7NVIJ9hRzRZV8y4JrERKvDroZg%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>项目简介</strong>：使用 WebGi 引擎构建的可滚动落地页模板，基于修改版 Three.js，支持高级渲染效果。</p>
<p><strong>技术栈</strong>：WebGi + TypeScript + Parcel + GSAP ScrollTrigger</p>
<p><strong>核心特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>滚动触发动画</li>
<li>高级 3D 渲染效果</li>
<li>仅 20 行代码实现核心渲染</li>
<li>流畅的滚动叙事体验</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-19">技术栈总结</h2>









































<table><thead><tr><th>技术</th><th>使用项目</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Three.js</strong></td><td>全部项目</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Vue 3</strong></td><td>MF-2.5DMap、MF-TurbineMonitor、MF-StationMonitor、MF-NetworkMonitor、MF-PlaneGraph、ThreeMaps</td></tr><tr><td><strong>React</strong></td><td>sc-datav</td></tr><tr><td><strong>TypeScript</strong></td><td>大部分项目</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Vite</strong></td><td>MF-2.5DMap、MF-TurbineMonitor、MF-StationMonitor、MF-NetworkMonitor、MF-PlaneGraph、ThreeMaps、sc-datav</td></tr><tr><td><strong>GSAP</strong></td><td>3d-earth、sc-datav、ThreeMaps、day-night-digital-twins、webgi-jewelry</td></tr><tr><td><strong>ECharts</strong></td><td>sc-datav、ThreeMaps</td></tr><tr><td><strong>WebGi</strong></td><td>webgi-jewelry</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-20">学习建议</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>入门推荐</strong>：从&nbsp;<code>3d-earth</code>&nbsp;开始，学习基础的 Three.js 地球渲染</li>
<li><strong>进阶学习</strong>：<code>MF-TurbineMonitor</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>MF-StationMonitor</code>&nbsp;展示了完整的数字孪生实现</li>
<li><strong>地图可视化</strong>：<code>MF-2.5DMap</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>sc-datav</code>&nbsp;是学习 GeoJSON + Three.js 的好案例</li>
<li><strong>现代技术栈</strong>：<code>sc-datav</code>&nbsp;使用了 React 19 + Vite + Rolldown 最新技术组合</li>
</ol>
